newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong top judge accepts leadership nomination.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong top judge accepts leadership nomination.

text.p: Hong Kong's top judge said he would accept nomination as a candidate to be the first chief executive of the territory after its handover to China, the judiciary said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement said a decision would be taken on Chief Justice Sir Ti Liang Yang's future as the head of the judiciary only when the nomination was formally lodged with China's Selection Committee.
Hong Kong's next leader, who will take over from Governor Chris Patten at midnight on June 30 next year, will be chosen by a 400-member Selection Committee now being formed.
Nominations to the Selection Committee close on September 14 and the chief executive-designate is due to be named by November.
